title: Canonical Installment Reference
description: Closed canonical identity of one installment within a publisher-scoped collection. Only the identity members below are permitted, so the same installment always has one reference value and a set of references always serializes to the same JCS bytes. Use this wherever a reference is matched by identity against a canonical set — digest-covered terms, and references a receiving agent resolves and acts on. core/installment-ref.json stays open for delivery-reporting rows, where a reference is a self-identifying dimension key rather than something compared against a reference set, so extra members are harmless. Resolution is against the referenced product's declared installments; the publisher_domain names the adagents.json that scopes the collection ID and MUST NOT be dereferenced to resolve a reference.

collection_ref.title: Canonical Collection Reference
collection_ref.description: Closed parent collection identity. Collection IDs are scoped to the adagents.json at publisher_domain, so both members participate in identity.

installment_id.description: Installment ID within the referenced collection.
